scenes.text: Count by 2s: 12, 14, 16, blank . What comes next? Let us think carefully. Add 2 each time. The answer is 18. Great work!
Count by 5s: 35, 40, 45, blank . What is missing? Let us think carefully. Add 5 each time. The answer is 50. Great work!
Count by 10s: 120, 130, 140, blank . What comes next? Let us think carefully. Add 10 each time. The answer is 150. Great work!
Count by 2s: 44, 46, 48, blank . What is missing? Let us think carefully. Add 2 each time. The answer is 50. Great work!
